historical_reference.source: zinc_structural_object_tokens_v1 frozen REPORT/analysis; no prediction rows reused

C.clip_semantics: C: single update gradient, norm recorded before clip_grad_norm_(5) and clipped when above 5
C.note: perturbed_train_mae is the second-pass normalised L1 at theta+eps; it is not the normal train MAE and not a sharpness measurement

S.clip_semantics: S: g1 is raw and never clipped (g1_over_clip_updates counts norms>5); only the second-pass gradient g2 is clipped to 5 (g2_clip_fraction)
S.note: perturbed_train_mae is the second-pass normalised L1 at theta+eps; it is not the normal train MAE and not a sharpness measurement

fraction_candidate_better_semantics: molecule-level fraction whose AE is smaller (an unpaired sign count), not the fraction of bootstrap resamples
note: paired bootstrap resamples the 1,000 test molecules; it does not represent across-seed training uncertainty
